text:
Type: white leaning ladder shelf
Use: displaying towels, plants, books and baskets in a slim space; bathroom, living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, coastal
Materials: white painted wood rails and shelves, black wall fixings
Colors: white, black accents
Shape: tall slim ladder frame leaning against the wall, two long angled side rails, several shallow shelves, top bar for hanging towels, airy and light
Feel: airy, fresh, relaxed, light
Goes with: white walls, light wood floors, linen towels, green plants; Scandinavian, coastal or spa-like rooms
